name: StableDomains
summary: Agent-first domain registrar: an agent can search, buy, renew and manage real ICANN domain names over a REST API, an MCP server or x402, paying in USDC or USDT on several chains with no card; it also sells domain-drop data per call over x402 (USDC on Base, $0.01-$0.10) and runs a referral…
disclosure: Disclosure: suggested for the Atlas by the operator, Tim Johnson (StableDomains), in an email to Commonworld on 2026-10-29. No payment, deal or paid placement is involved, and the card does not depend on one. Every value was re-checked read-only by the Atlas against the site's own pages, its live 402 answers, Coinbase's Bazaar and the MCP Registry.

claims.statement: https://stabledomains.net is the official address: the home page declares it as rel=canonical, www. and http:// answer 308 to it, and the About page says it is the operator's only site (not the unrelated stabledomains.dev).
claims.quote: We are not affiliated with stabledomains.dev or any other similarly named site. Our only site is stabledomains.net.

claims.statement: The home page answers HTTP 200 with the same body on two reads (36,624 bytes, sha256 a15d18c20590..., 13:50:46Z and 14:00Z) and the About page to a separate fetcher.
claims.quote: StableDomains.net | Real domains. Paid in stablecoins. Bought by agents.
methods: curl -s -A "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; CommonworldAtlasVerify/1.0)" https://stabledomains.net/ (HTTP 200, 36624 B, sha256 a15d18c20590, twice)

claims.statement: Operator's description: an agent-first domain registrar where domains are searched, bought, renewed and managed, paid in stablecoins, from a browser, a REST API, x402 or MCP.
claims.quote: An agent-first domain registrar. Search, buy, renew and manage domain names, paid in stablecoins, from a browser, a REST API, x402 or MCP.

claims.statement: Operated by Tim Johnson, trading as StableDomains, in England; a reseller that registers domains through NiceNIC International Group Co., Limited (ICANN-accredited, IANA ID 3765), per the About page and the terms (last updated 28 October 2026).
claims.quote: StableDomains is operated by Tim Johnson, trading as StableDomains, in England.

claims.statement: Public documentation for agents: llms.txt, an OpenAPI 3.1 file, a docs page and an MCP server card.

Commonworld's own unpaid check: an unpaid GET to https://stabledomains.net/api/v1/drops/full answered HTTP 402 with x402 v2 payment terms (scheme exact; network eip155:8453 (Base); asset USDC; price 0.01 USDC; payTo 0xf773ea4A371114f12A4b82B6dE0b5ED3A6e2504B). All six paid GET resources listed in /.well-known/x402 answered 402 with the same network and payTo and the prices listed there (availability/bulk 0.10, valuation 0.02, alerts 0.01, drops/full 0.01, suggest/bulk 0.02, radar/full 0.02 USDC). No payment was made; a 402 shows the endpoint is up and asks for payment, not that the paid service works. Per the same discovery file the operator also offers a seventh resource, POST https://stabledomains.net/api/v1/register, which registers a domain at a dynamic USDC price quoted in its 402; the Atlas did not call it (no POST, no payment). The /x402 page names four resources: drops/full, suggest/bulk, register and domain orders.
claims.quote: POST /api/v1/register {domain, years} registers a domain at the live quote (dynamic USDC price in the 402; premium/unavailable refused before payment; idempotent per payment).
methods: curl -s -A "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; CommonworldAtlasVerify/1.0)" https://stabledomains.net/.well-known/x402 (HTTP 200, application/json; 7 resources: six paid GET plus POST /api/v1/register)
unpaid GET https://stabledomains.net/api/v1/drops/full (HTTP 402, x402Version 2, amount 10000; no payment header sent)
unpaid GET of the other five GET resources in https://stabledomains.net/.well-known/x402 (HTTP 402 each; amounts 100000, 20000, 10000, 20000, 20000)
POST https://stabledomains.net/api/v1/register not called (state-changing and paid)
